description: This file defines the _Checkpointer class, providing a high-level API for saving and loading distributed state dictionaries in PyTorch, utilizing storage, load, and save planners, and integrating with torch.distributed.

classes.name: _Checkpointer
classes.description: A base class providing high-level API for saving and loading distributed state_dicts in PyTorch.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the _Checkpointer with storage, process group, and planner configurations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the state_dict using the saver, returning Metadata.

methods.name: async_save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the state_dict, returning a Future with Metadata.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the state_dict using the loader.
